alerts.reason: VIAVI’s year-over-year revenue decline narrowed from 10.54% in December to 0.73% in March (A). Stronger OSP demand supports a forecast that the intervening quarter stays above −5%. OSP only partly offset weakness among service-provider and enterprise customers, and demand remained volatile (B, C). I forecast those pressures push consolidated revenue growth to −5% or below in the quarter starting June 30.
